description:
👉*Try Abacus AI* — https://studio.abacus.ai/fmj

*Five iPhone apps went from a typed sentence to a real phone with zero Xcode, and one is a GPS zombie chase that overran its own builder twice on a street in Bengaluru.*

Type a sentence, get code. That part is solved. The step almost everyone is stuck on is Apple's side: *Xcode*, signing certificates, App Store Connect, *TestFlight*. That pipeline was built for iOS engineers, and it just became a button in a chat window.

What you'll learn:
✅ How a *lamp store* went from prompt to TestFlight install in minutes
✅ The moment the agent said *no* to a bloated sleep app spec and rewrote it
✅ Live GPS run tracking tested on real hardware, not a browser preview

The death screen at thirty-two seconds is the most convincing thing in this video.

#AI #AppDevelopment #NoCode
